recent_commits.message:
Add restructure maps for pump, pump_amm, mayhem (recovered targets + current->recovered)

Completes the mapping for all 4 contracts. Documents each recovered module tree (Location-
bearing files) + the inferable current->recovered file mapping, with honest caveats: the
recovered tree is PARTIAL (only panic-Location-bearing files appear), the reconstruction
groups by operation vs the original by interface (requires merging + renaming the shared
`handler` fn), so a faithful compiling tree for these three is partly inferred (unlike
pump_fees near-1:1). mayhem is the most determinable.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #31 from AlleyBo55/independent-ebpf-crosscheck

Add independent sBPF cross-check of ATA reserve_for_push ordering

Merge pull request #28 from SYMBaiEX/codex/collector-reproducible-build

Reproduce the tested collector executable and symbols

Complete pump_fees restructured reference tree (all recovered module files, compiling)

Finishes the oracle-guided restructure: every recovered pump_fees module file is now
materialized and the crate compiles (v1.44). fee_sharing group (create_social_fee_pda,
claim_social_fee_pda, create_donation_fee_pda, admin_cto_sharing_config, update_fee_shares,
update_fee_shares_v2) + buyback + withdraw moved cleanly (bodies preserved); inline admin
handlers delegated into instructions/admin/* and shared helpers into common/mod.rs
(structural-only, bodies regress as expected). Oracle: 2/30 Location sites now match exactly
(up from 0), several files MISSING->PARTIAL. Reference artifact under repro/ (not active
source; not byte-closing). See pump-fees-restructured/README.md + ../RESTRUCTURE-MAP.md.
